rule: The article, adjective, and verb must match whether the noun is one or more: el gato negro duerme / los gatos negros duermen. Add -s after a vowel and -es after a consonant (el mes → los meses).

examples.note: Plural noun, so las, están, abiertas.
padres is plural, so viven not vive.

common_mistake: Leaving the adjective singular ('casas blanco') or forgetting that the verb also has to change with the subject.
